text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why is she being called out
specifically? Is
she special or something?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... She's pretty small. Maybe she
expects
special treatment? She ran well,
though, so that's
promising.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, interesting.
Hey! Make sure you
listen to what the grown-ups
say!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that about sums it up! Sweep,
Trainer,
please make sure you're on time
for the concert!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! I'd like to talk to you alone
for a
minute!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We've heard about what happened the
other
day...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Would you like me to come to the
waiting room
twenty minutes
beforehand? I can call for extra
help if
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember the conversation I had with
Sweep
Tosho's grandmother.
choice_data_list: ……それは心配だからでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
But have you ever felt that people are
worrying
about you so much because
they might not have
faith in you?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is, the staff who were there on
the day
of her debut have been rather
worried.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
They said she's very spoiled, and they're
worried
she might suddenly back out of
the concert...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Wouldn't it be best to set
up some
kind of contingency plan just in
case?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
...All right, then. You're her trainer, so if
you say
so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin J.F. concert begins. Sweep
Tosho
takes the stage right on time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she does exactly what she's
supposed to do.
